home.title: Home
home.emptyState: No earthquakes reported in your region recently.

map.title: Map
map.emptyState: The map view is coming in a later phase.

sensor.title: Sensor
sensor.unavailable: This device doesn't have a motion sensor Bumelerze can read, so the live view isn't available here.
sensor.permissionDenied: Bumelerze needs motion-sensor access to show the live view. You can allow it from your device settings.

explainer.sentence1: Your phone contains a tiny accelerometer chip — the same physics a professional seismometer uses to measure shaking.
explainer.sentence2: Shake your phone gently and watch your own seismogram appear below.
explainer.sentence3: This view is just for you — nothing here is recorded, saved, or sent anywhere.

sensor.gravityNote: With gravity on, a phone lying still still shows a steady line on one axis — that's Earth's gravity, not shaking. Turn gravity off to see only motion.
sensor.axisA11yHint: Show or hide the {{axis}} axis on the chart
sensor.chartA11yLabel: Live accelerometer chart showing the last ten seconds of motion

safety.title: Safety
safety.emptyState: Safety guidance (before, during, and after an earthquake) is coming in a later phase.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageSectionDescription: Choose the language Bumelerze displays. Switching to or from a right-to-left language restarts the app.
settings.languageRestartNotice: Restarting to apply the new language…
settings.languageRestartFailedMessage: Please close and reopen Bumelerze to finish switching languages.

eventDetail.title: Event detail
